Munajat: Supplications

Imam Jafar al-Sadiq (a)

O my God, I seek of Your Glory (baha') by the Most-Glorious.
All Your Glory is Glorious.
O my God I seek in Your Glory all existence.

O my God, I seek of Your Beauty (jamal) by the Most-Beautiful.
All Your Beauty is Beautiful.
O my God I seek in Your Beauty all existence.

O my God, I seek of Your Majesty (jalal) by the Most-Majestic.
All Your Majesty is Majestic.
O my God I seek in Your Majesty all existence.

O my God, I seek of Your Might ('izzat) by the Most-Mighty.
All Your Might is Mighty.
O my God I seek in Your Might all existence.

O my God, I seek of Your Light (nur) by the Most-Luminous.
All Your Light is Luminous.
O my God I seek in Your Light all existence.

O my God, I seek of Your Mercy by the Most-Magnificent (wasi').
All Your Mercy is Magnimonious.
O my God I seek in Your Mercy all existence.

O my God I seek in Your Word (kalam) by the Most-Complete (tamm).
All Your Word is Complete.
O my God I seek in Your Word all existence.

O my God I seek of Your Perfection (kamal) by the Most-Perfect.
All Your Perfection is Perfectional.
O my God I seek of Your Perfection all existence.

O my God I seek of Your Names ('asma') by the Most-Great Name.
All Your Names are Great.
O my God I seek of Your Names all existence.

O my God I seek of Your Exaltation ('azim) by the Most-Exalted.
All Your Exaltation is Exalted.
O my God I seek of Your Exaltation all existence.

O my God, I seek of Your Will (mashi'a) by the Most-Contented (raDa')
All Your Will is Contented.
O my God I seek of Your Will all existence.

O my God, I seek of Your Power (qudrat) by the Most-Powerful.
All Your Power is Powerful.
O my God I seek of Your Power all existence.

O my God, I seek of Your Knowledge ('ilm) by the Most-Realized (nafadh).
All Your Knowledge is Realized.
O my God I seek of Your Knowledge all existence.

O my God, I seek of Your Speech (qawwal) by the Most-Accepting (raDa').
All Your Speech is Accepting.
O my God I seek of Your Speech all existence.

O my God, I seek of Your Question (masa'il) by the Gatherer (jami').
All Your Questioning unto You is Gathered.
O my God I seek of Your Question all existence.

O my God I seek of Your Honour (sharaf) by the Most-Honorable.
All Your Honor is Honorable.
O my God I seek of Your Honor all existence.

O my God, I seek of Your Authority (sultan) by the Sustaining (duwan).
All Your Authority is Sustainable.
O my God, I seek of Your Authority all existence.

O God, I seek of Your Dominion (mulk) by the Splenderous (fakhir).
All Your Dominion is Splendid.
O my God, I seek of Your Dominion all existnce.

O my God, I seek of Your Highness ('ala) by the Most-High.
All Your Highness is High.
O my God, I seek of Your Highness all existence.

O my God, I seek of Your Enactment (sana) by the Pre-Existent (qadim).
All Your Enacting is Pre-Existing.
O my God, I seek of Your Enactment all existence.

O my God, I seek of Your Signs ('ayat) by the Noble (karim).
All Your Signs are Noble.
O my God I seek Your Signs all existence.

O my God I seek for repose (malanat) in the [Names] The Defender (al-shan), the Powerful (al-jabarut), through these all [existence] persists (shana), Unifier (wahdah) and One Power (jabarut wahid).
O my God I seek in these Names shelter (janaba) unto all time, I seek shelter
O Lord (ya Allah).
